cards.card_text: They stagger and go out of their minds (Jeremiah 25:16).
cards.verse_text: And they will drink and stagger and go out of their minds, because of the sword that I will send among them.”

cards.card_text: The LORD says the nations will stagger and go out of their minds because of a famine He will send among them.
cards.verse_text: And they will drink and stagger and go out of their minds, because of the sword that I will send among them.”
